A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and provide complete, readable main text and Appendices A-H. All appendix pages match textually and visually after accounting for the pagination shift.

before.justification: v3 reports original LoRA compression, task-performance, and serving-throughput experiments in Section 6 and the appendices, including ablations and numerical result tables.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including the serving experiments, compression evaluations, and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: JD-Full, JD-Diag, clustering, optimization algorithms, and serving integration are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices A and F.

E1.justification: Both retain the same natural-instruction tasks, Shakespeare-sonnet serving inputs, and out-of-distribution evaluation in Appendix H.13. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including SVD and TIES-merging in the appendix tables and vLLM multi-LoRA in the serving comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported splits, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, compression iterations, and memory-matched serving procedures are unchanged in Sections 5-6 and the appendices.

E4.justification: The rank and clustering studies, privacy ablation, trained-versus-random reconstruction analysis, convergence tests, and out-of-distribution analysis are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Section 6.1 retains three runs with different random seeds and reporting of means and standard deviations. The uncertainty displays and appendix reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: The result entries, plotted findings, and numerical summaries are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains LoRA Rouge-L of 67.80 ± 30.15; the appendix result tables also match exactly.

T1.justification: Section 4's proposition, theorem, and corollary, together with the derivations and proofs in Appendices A-B, are unchanged. The theoretical footnote is only renumbered.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and discussion retain the same claims about joint compression, clustering, reconstruction guarantees, preserved task performance, and serving throughput.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning reconstruction error, generalization, clustering, and privacy remain unchanged, as do the scaling limitations and future directions in Section 7.

D1.justification: v4 removes v3's abstract footnote linking directly to the Lots-of-LoRAs collection, without supplying a replacement elsewhere. Implementation details and the release promise remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish any change in the collection's actual availability.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Reference author initials are expanded into full names, which is a bibliography-style change rather than added related work.

P1.justification: v4 adds acknowledgements, an equal-contribution note, and ICML proceedings information, and changes reference-name formatting. The scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The publication block, acknowledgements, and expanded bibliography cause limited text reflow and an additional reference page. Figures 1-6 and Tables 1-20 retain their displays; appendix contents simply shift by one page.

improvement.justification: The scientific content and supporting evidence are unchanged, but v4 removes the sole direct link to the LoRA collection while retaining the release promise, slightly reducing practical reproducibility. Added acknowledgements and publication details improve attribution but do not replace the lost access information.
